entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The sons of David. 10 His line to Zedekiah. 17 The successors of Jeconiah.

A.M. 2951, etc. B.C. 1053, etc. the sons of David. 2Sa 3:2-5 Amnon. 2Sa 13:1,29 Ahinoam. 1Sa 25:42,43; 27:3 Jezreelitess. Jos 15:56 Daniel.It is probable this person had two names. The Targumist says he was "called Chileab, because he was in every respect like his father."

2Sa 3:3 of Abigail. 1Sa 25:39-42

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Eglah.The Targumist, Jarchi, and others, maintain that this was Michal; and though it is stated (2 Sa 6:23) that "she had no child to the day of her death," yet she might have had a child before, at that time living.

2Sa 3:5

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: there he reigned. 2Sa 2:11; 5:4,5; 1Ki 2:11 and in Jerusalem. 2Sa 5:4,14-16

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Shimea. 14:4; 2Sa 5:14 Shammuah. Nathan. 2Sa 7:2-4; 12:1-15; Lu 3:31 Solomon. 28:5,6; 2Sa 12:24,25 Bath-shua. 2Sa 11:3 Bath-sheba. Mt 1:6 Ammiel. 2Sa 11:3 Eliam.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Elishama. 14:5; 2Sa 5:15 Elishua. Eliphelet. 1Sa 14:5 Elpalet.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Eliada. 14:7 Beeliada. Eliphelet. 14:7; 2Sa 5:14-16 Eliphalet.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: of the concubines. 2Sa 5:13 Tamar. 2Sa 13:1-20

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Rehoboam. 1Ki 11:43; 14:31; 15:6; Mt 1:7 Roboam. Abia. 1Ki 15:1 Abijam. 2Ch 13:1 Abijah. Asa. 1Ki 15:8; 2Ch 14:1 Jehoshaphat. 1Ki 15:24; 2Ch 17:1; Mt 1:8 Josaphat.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Joram. 1Ki 22:50; 2Ch 21:1 Jehoram. Ahaziah. 2Ki 8:24; 2Ch 21:17 Jehoahaz. 22:1-6 Azariah. Joash. 2Ki 11:21; 2Ch 24:1

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Amaziah. 2Ki 14:1; 2Ch 25:1 Azariah. 2Ki 14:21; 15:30; 2Ch 26:1 Uzziah. Mt 1:8,9 Ozias. Jotham. 2Ki 15:5,32; 2Ch 27:1; Mt 1:9 Joatham.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Ahaz. 2Ki 16:1; 2Ch 28:1-8; Mt 1:9 Achaz. Hezekiah. 2Ki 18:1; 2Ch 29:1; Mt 1:9 Ezekias. Manasseh. 2Ki 21:1; 2Ch 33:1; Mt 1:10 Manasses.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Amon. 2Ki 21:19; 2Ch 33:20,21 Josiah. 2Ki 22:1; 2Ch 34:1; Mt 1:10,11 Josias. Johanan. or, Jehoahaz. 2Ki 23:30 Jehoiakim. 2Ki 23:34 Eliakim. 2Ch 36:5; Jer 22:18 Zedekiah. 2Ki 24:17,18 Mattaniah. 2Ch 36:11 Shallum.The Targumist says he was called Shallum, "because the kingdom departed from the house of David in his days."

2Ki 23:30; 2Ch 36:1 Jehoahaz. Jer 22:11

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Jeconiah. 2Ki 24:6,8; 25:27; 2Ch 36:9 Jehoiachin. Jer 22:24,28 Coniah. Mt 1:11 Jechonias. Zedekiah.As the sons of Jeconiah are enumerated in the succeeding verse, and as Zedekiah is no where else mentioned as the son of Jeconiah, but as the son of Josiah, it is highly probable that son here means successor.

15; 2Ki 24:17 being his uncle.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:17
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Assir.As Salathiel was not the son of Assir, but of Jeconiah, it is probable that the word {assir,} which signifies a prisoner, is an ephithet applied to Jeconiah, who was a long time prisoner at Babylon.

Salathiel. Ezr 3:2,8; 5:2 Shealtiel. Mt 1:12

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
the sons of Pedaiah.As St. Matthew states that Zerubbabel was the son of Salathiel, Houbigant thinks these words should be omitted; and Pedaiah is wanting in the Arabic and Syriac.

Zerubbabel. Ezr 2:2; 3:2; Hag 1:12-14; 2:2,4; Zec 4:6-9; Mt 1:12 Zorobabel.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:22
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Hattush. Ezr 8:2 six.Five only are enumerated in the text, which Houbigant would substitute as the true reading; but probably the father is reckoned with his sons.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 3:23
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Hezekiah. or, Hiskijahu. 23
